_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pregnancy" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "dating_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "lmp" TEXT NULL, "cycle_length" INTEGER NULL, "anchor_date" TEXT NULL, "embryo_day" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "twins" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("twins" IN (0, 1)), "high_risk" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("high_risk" IN (0, 1)), "exercise_cleared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exercise_cleared" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checklist_tick" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("pregnancy_id", "item_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "doctor_name" TEXT NULL, "clinic_name" TEXT NULL, "clinic_phone" TEXT NULL, "clinic_address" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NULL, "stock" INTEGER NULL, "refill_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplement_schedule" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "supplement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES supplement (id), "minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 127, "label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dose_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES supplement_schedule (id), "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("schedule_id", "due_at"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "template_key" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" TEXT NULL, "done_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("pregnancy_id", "template_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "appointment" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "doctor" TEXT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "bring_along" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visit_question" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "appointment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES appointment (id), "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "asked_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachment" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "appointment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES appointment (id), "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vital_reading" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value1" REAL NOT NULL, "value2" REAL NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total" INTEGER NULL, "last_opened_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "library_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES library_item (id), "routine_key" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "letter" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "pregnancy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pregnancy (id), "body" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
